name: L. C. Hunt
bio: L. C. Hunt, a recent law graduate of the University of Michigan, came to Medora in October 1885 to learn the cattle business, and at the end of January 1886 bought Frank Moore's interest in the KC ranch and became manager of the KC herd. In September 1886, while he and his brother Robert were loading KC cattle at Dickinson, they learned their father had died at Fort Union, New Mexico, where L. C. went to bury him.
